FINAL MISSION — IVX IA SENIOR DEVELOPER PRODUCTION COMPLETION (END-TO-END)

OBJECTIVE
Complete IVX IA as a production-grade senior developer system. Do not leave placeholders, mock implementations, or partial features. Execute all remaining work through completion, verify with automated and manual testing, and only mark tasks complete after evidence is collected.

PHASE 1 — STABILIZE
- Resolve all critical runtime errors.
- Resolve authentication failures.
- Remove duplicate logic and dead code.
- Verify environment variables are loaded correctly.
- Verify database migrations are applied.
- Verify API health and error handling.

PHASE 2 — OWNER PLATFORM
Verify end-to-end:
- Owner login
- Session persistence
- Password recovery
- Role-based permissions
- Owner Dashboard
- Admin Hub
- Settings
- Audit logging

PHASE 3 — CORE MODULES
Verify each module independently:
- Members
- Investors
- Buyers
- Properties
- Investment Cards
- Reels
- Chat
- Notifications
- Documents
- Media uploads
- Search
- Analytics
- CRM
- Revenue
- Reports

PHASE 4 — DATA INTEGRITY
- Verify all production tables.
- Validate relationships.
- Eliminate duplicate records.
- Restore missing references where applicable.
- Verify uploads and media links.
- Verify synchronization across supported platforms.

PHASE 5 — UI/UX QA
- Remove loading loops.
- Remove white screens.
- Remove layout jumps.
- Verify keyboard behavior.
- Verify navigation.
- Verify responsive layouts.
- Verify accessibility basics.
- Verify dark/light themes if supported.

PHASE 6 — PERFORMANCE
- Optimize database queries.
- Reduce API latency.
- Optimize images and videos.
- Minimize unnecessary network requests.
- Improve startup time.
- Verify memory usage.
- Check crash-free startup.

PHASE 7 — SECURITY
- Verify authorization on protected routes.
- Validate input handling.
- Verify secrets are not exposed.
- Confirm HTTPS usage.
- Review API authorization.
- Review storage permissions.

PHASE 8 — TESTING
Complete:
- Unit tests
- Integration tests
- End-to-end tests
- Regression tests
- Manual smoke tests on:
  - Android
  - iOS
  - Web

PHASE 9 — RELEASE READINESS
Only proceed if:
- No critical defects remain.
- High-severity issues are resolved or explicitly accepted.
- Build succeeds.
- Database is healthy.
- APIs are healthy.
- Authentication works.
- Monitoring is enabled.

FINAL DELIVERABLES
Provide evidence including:
1. Git commit SHA(s)
2. Release/build version
3. Deployment identifier (if applicable)
4. Build logs
5. Test summary with pass/fail counts
6. List of resolved issues
7. List of any remaining known issues (if any)
8. Confirmation of production health checks
9. Confirmation that all critical user flows were successfully tested

Do not report "completed" unless these verification steps have actually been performed and documented with evidence.
